notes.title: New save system
notes.notes:
I've finally been able to change the old save system of the game! If you didn't know, in the old system everything was saved in the registry. 

Now it is saved in a file which is located here:
AppData\LocalLow\LiftyGames\Riddles And Sieges\

The file name is SavedData.sav.

The system itself wasn't very hard to do, but the reason I didn't do it before because I didn't want anyone to lose their progress. But now I was able to make the progress from the registry transfer to this file when you will launch the game after this update.

[b]So don't worry, you will not lose your progress.[/b] (At least every test showed progress being transfered properly).

This also means that now there is steam cloud support! So you don't have to worry about losing your save file.

Also work is underway on a new update, which will bring a new zone, that is pretty unique compared to all of the other ones.

That is all for now!

notes.title: Secrets Of The Ancients Update
notes.notes:
After defeating everyone that has opposed your kingdom, the next thing to do was to get richer, of course. And what better way to do so, than to find the remains of an ancient civilization, that was swimming in gold, but has been long gone.


[h2][b]What is new?[/b][/h2]

Secrets Of The Ancients update brings 15 new levels to Riddles & Sieges, as well as other additional content!

New zones to explore and complete: Spring, Arrow Trap and Firespitter! As always, all these zones have 5 leves each, containing different new main mechanics, as well as additional means of defense.

Also this new zone has something that hasn't been done in the game before: [b]a secret level![/b] Something is hidden in some of those levels. Can you be the chosen one to finally open the ancient temple of secrets?


[h2][b]So what are these new mechanics?[/b][/h2]

[b]Spring:[/b]
It is a small wooden box with a metal spring attached to it. You probably already guessed what it does, but in case you didn't - it launches projectiles when the fall onto it. So basically, it gives another chance to any projectile that comes in contact with it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767678/0b7309bb2a1af4043bf11b849810de0445f6722b.gif[/img]


[b]Arrow Trap:[/b]
An old trap used by the ancients to guard their temples from unwanted trespassers. They were made from very dense material, which makes them almost impossible to destroy. These traps work like a ballista does, but with the exception that they do not get destroyed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767678/c8d55ba929857b6d589aa9b1becf5420b55d6bf5.gif[/img]


[b]Firespitter:[/b]
Another piece of ancient weaponry, although much more advanced. This trap can sense everything, that is in front of it. As soon as there are any irregularities, it shoots a flaming ball forward, burning everyone in its way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767678/0bb43054e38ee2600e1707eb3d019f681e3452fa.gif[/img]


[b]New defense building: Torch Tower[/b]
Torches were very important in the lives of the ancients, as they believed that fire was the best creation of the world itself, and the most useful one aswell. This tower acts like a normal tower, but it is half the height of it.


[h2][b]Other changes[/b][/h2]
There are some quality of life changes, as well as fixes and new additions. 2 new music tracks have been added, a new custom cursor for the game and the ability to control camera zoom in the level editor!

And of course the secret level, but you will have to see it yourself!



[h2][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added World 2
[*] Added new zone in world 2 - Ancient Ruins
[*] Added new mechanic - Spring - 5 levels
[*] Added new mechanic - Arrow Trap - 5 levels
[*] Added new mechanic - Firespitter - 5 levels
[*] Added new defense building - Torch Tower
[*] Added new castle building - Ancient Temple
[*] The game now features a custom cursor
[*] 2 new soundtracks have been added to the game, credit can be found in the game's credit list
[*] Credits list now features a scroll bar, so that it can be expanded easier
[*] New type of level - Secret level
[*] Added camera zooming to level editor
[*] Fixed most of the icons (especially in level editor) being very low resolution
[*] Updated the localization to fit the new changes
[*] New environments for the level editor - Ancient Ruins Environments
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.15
notes.notes:
This patch brings some new features, as well as level balances and reworks.

New additions to the game:
- Music. There are now 4 different soundtracks in game. Of course a music slider is now present in the settings menu. You can find credits for the music in the settings.
- You can now see the level number while playing that level in the top left corner near the pause button.
- Hotkeys. You can now start, retry and restart the level by only using your keyboard.
- Pause button. It is possible to open the pause menu with the mouse by clicking the pause menu button.
- You can now open the level select from the pause menu.
- Units can now be rotated using the mouse wheel.
- You can now skip levels if you want by clicking the skip level button in the pause menu.


Other changes and fixes:
- Camera controls have been disabled (except in the level editor). All levels are now made to fit inside the camera field of view, which means you won't have to scroll back and forth to play the level and can always see everything.
- Fixed localization not working correctly in some places.
- Rebalanced levels 30, 33, 34, 38, 39 and 40.
- Completely remade level 35.
- Fixed a bug where you could press the buttons when settings menu was open.
- Currently chosen level is now outlined in the level select menu.
- The retry button is now grayed out when in planning mode.
- Changed previews of some levels.
- Fixed a bug which prevented you from clicking on units and other things in the level editor at certain places on the screen.

notes.title: Riddles & Sieges is OUT NOW 🏰
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767678/b5c873cac5b95cc620a43b230e21b3879e7a28f2.png[/img]

[b]It is finally time! Riddles & Sieges is now available on Steam![/b]

Check out the latest trailer here:
[previewyoutube=dNxH3IDYvT8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]About:[/b]
Riddles & Sieges is a medieval puzzle game where you use old siege weapons to solve puzzles.

Each building works and attacks differently. For example catapult shoots over a tile. Trebuchet does the same, but has a delay before attacking. And ballista only attacks when being destroyed.


[b]The game features:[/b]
- 40 handcrafted levels with each one being harder than the previous

- A lot different mechanics that keep you interested throughout the whole game
- Custom Level Editor if you want to create levels of your own and share them with everyone!
- Calming atmosphere that keeps you relaxed while solving the puzzles

[b]Levels:[/b]
There are 40 levels in total handcrafted for your enjoyment. These levels are spread in 3 different zones. Those being:

- Sunny Fields - 15 levels
- Wintery Weather - 15 levels
- A Rainy Day - 10 levels
Every zone is also divided in mechanics, with each being 5 levels in total. And those are only the main mechanics. Sometimes additional mechanics will appear, making the game even more interesting!
